pages.title: Specimen Bundle
pages.text: One of everything a mod's world grows or leaves behind, sealed in glass.

One for each mod: one of every meat and drop (with an egg) or every crop, seed, fruit and flower (with bone meal) that mod has, gathered on the Extreme Assembly Table. Too many bundles are bound nine at a time into an Archive. The Biosphere Compendium and the Primordial Harvest want them all.
